name: Den yngste kongssønnen
description: Den yngste av tolv prinser, utholdende og observant, som alene tar sjansen, dreper uhyret, henter kronene og avslører løgnen når makt og frykt prøver å stilne sannheten.
visualPrompt: Young Nordic prince in his early 20s with salt-tangled dark-blond hair and tired eyes, lean and weathered from years at sea, wearing a plain, oversized sailor’s coat and practical boots; he carries a battered wooden crate and later a locked cabinet heavy with twelve gold crowns; expression steady, guarded, determined; contemporary fairytale style.

name: Ridder Rød
description: Den erfarne styrmannen i rød jakke som styrer ekspedisjonen og senere stjeler æren med trusler, vold og en påtvunget forlovelse.
visualPrompt: Broad-shouldered middle-aged man with hard jaw and slicked-back dark hair, wearing a vivid red jacket over modern maritime gear; confident predatory smile, cold eyes; posture like a man used to command; hands ready to seize; modern fairytale villain aesthetic.

name: Den yngste prinsessen
description: Den mest stille av de tolv, merket av fangenskapet og trusselen fra Ridder Rød, men modig nok til å peke ut sannheten når kronene kommer fram.
visualPrompt: Young woman in her early 20s with pale, exhausted face and long ash-brown hair, wearing simple elegant modern dress in muted tones; eyes alert with contained fear turning to resolve; she holds herself upright despite trembling hands; a bare steel sword lies as a boundary near her sleeping place; contemporary fairy-tale realism.

name: Fugl Dam
description: En gigantisk, gåtefull hjelpefugl som krever fire tønner rug som betaling og flyr prinsen forbi skipet og mot oppgjøret, som en gammel kraft midt i moderne verden.
visualPrompt: Enorm bird filling a courtyard, feathers textured like intertwined cables and rough bark, eyes ancient and intelligent; a single neck feather as thick as a small tree trunk; powerful wings half-spread; it bears uneven cargo balanced on each side; presence both protective and unsettling; modern mythic creature style.

name: Trollkongen (øya-slottet)
description: Den skremmende, kalkulerende herskeren i det skjulte slottet som gir prinsen styrke og verktøy, men alltid med sin egen agenda og krav om gjenytelser.
visualPrompt: Tall, imposing troll-king figure with coarse grayish skin and heavy features, dressed in a strange blend of antique regalia and modern tailored garments; jewelry and worn insignia glint against dark fabric; expression measured, transactional, eerily calm; stands in a sleek stone-and-glass hall that feels both ancient and contemporary.
